result.title: VRLLM: Turning LLMs into Powerful Tabular Classifiers
result.summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown strong performance on text, but whether pretrained LLMs are effective for large-scale tabular classification remains unclear, as many previous works demonstrate that LLMs' tabular data classification performance falls behind tree-based models or neural architectures designed for tabular data. At Visa Research, we managed to fine-tune a pretrained Llama 3.2 1B LLM on billions of rows of labeled tabular data and make it outperform a wide array of tabular classifiers and even our competitive production deep learning model. For ease of reference, we refer to the model as the Visa Research LLM (VRLLM). In this paper, we share how we achieved this exciting result, covering data preparation, training recipe, ablation studies of design choices and deployment validation. We also benchmark frontier LLMs on the same task and analyze their prediction behavior across model families and generations. Our interpretability experiments suggest that VRLLM learns feature-specific predictive associations, while component ablations indicate that the earliest two FFN layers contribute to the emergence of linearly decodable task information. Our paper provides an engineering recipe and a focused empirical case study on adapting compact LLMs to industrial tabular prediction tasks.

AI.brief_summary: 论文报告在数十亿行带标注表格数据上微调 Llama 3.2 1B，得到在工业表格分类上超过多种树模型与自有生产深度模型的 VRLLM，并给出数据准备、训练配方、设计消融、部署验证及前沿 LLM 对比分析。
AI.relevance_reason: 与视觉推理无直接关联，但其按组件/FFN 层消融并用线性可解码性定位任务信息出现的做法，可能可供核查 LVR 中 latent 表示随层深出现与贡献分配的问题。
